author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Its JJ Abrams first big budget movie since Rise of Skywalker, and he chose... this. A film about a 1980s family whose entire neighbourhood gets transported back to the Jurassic period, and have to find a way home. Its basically Jurassic Park meets ET with a bit of family drama thrown in, and of course, the obligatory girlboss.
